summary: Genuinely deterministic when every other parameter is held constant, and the API returns the seed it used.
combines: Lixpi already generates one and stores what comes back, so exposing it as an editable field is mostly UI work.

usage.from: Existing generation seed policy, or a stable operation identity for typed pipeline calls
usage.what: Makes the provider request reproducible, then stores the seed reported by Stability on the generated Asset. It is not an editable composer option. The typed image.generate pipeline operation uses one Bedrock text-to-image request with durable authorization, native-result persistence, and a stable output slot.

note: Generated and recorded by the pipeline for every request; not a composer setting.
